selection: compare the fixed leaf-budget checkpoint for each branching width by validation Macro-F1; Accuracy tie-break; evaluate report/extra only after selection
checkpoint_rule: train exactly floor(target_leaf_outputs / (num_class * num_leaves)) boosting rounds; no early stopping or within-width checkpoint selection
budget_definition: upper bound on cumulative learned scalar leaf outputs across all class trees; split-node feature/threshold structure is reported separately and is not included in the matched budget
